summary: A model cannot run code: it asks for a tool and your code runs it. You write a tool with a name, a description and a schema, a function that looks up an error code, and the full loop: tool_use, your function, tool_result, final answer. The model in the run is a clearly labelled stand-in.
goal: Let the model call one function and print the result.

items.text: Add incident.py, tools.py and tool_call_demo.py and match the seven lines
Make the pretend reply ask for e104 and predict what happens
Ask for E999 and read which function raised the error
Print the second request and find the tool_use_id in two places
Write a test for run_tool and commit
Play the First Tool Call game to the end and see your score
